description: Every stock's FINRA short interest for one settlement date (default: the latest), ranked like livermore.club/en/shorts: by change in short shares since the previous settlement date (default; dir=asc gives the largest decreases), change_pct, days_to_cover or short_shares. Only stocks with an average daily volume of at least min_avg_volume shares (default 100,000) are listed, which keeps thinly traded stocks with huge percentage changes out. Rows with missing values, and with days to cover at FINRA's cap of 999.99 (dtc_capped true, days_to_cover null), are listed last in either direction. Each row has our ticker (null when FINRA's symbol is not matched to a listed company), FINRA's symbol, the company name, the market, the short interest figures and the stock's short interest page (url). recent_settlement_dates lists the latest 12 settlement dates. Short interest is reported twice a month, about 8 business days after the settlement date. There is no short interest as a percent of float. At most 200 rows per call; use page.

dir.description: desc = largest first (default); with sort=change, asc lists the largest decreases (covering).

min_avg_volume.description: Minimum average daily volume in shares (default 100,000), which keeps thinly traded stocks with huge percentage changes out.

page.description: Page number starting at 1; each page has `limit` rows. Check has_more.

settlement_date.description: FINRA settlement date, YYYY-MM-DD (mid-month and month-end). Default: the latest one.

sort.description: change = change in short shares since the previous settlement date (default), change_pct, days_to_cover or short_shares.

name: list_short_interest

days_to_cover.description: Short shares divided by average daily volume (FINRA). null when dtc_capped.

dtc_capped.description: FINRA reported its cap of 999.99 days (very low volume); days_to_cover is then null.

revision_flag.description: FINRA revised the previous settlement date's figure.

split_flag.description: FINRA flags a stock split since the previous settlement date.

symbol.description: FINRA's symbol as reported (BRKB for BRK.B).

title: Short interest rankings
